clauses.reason: The order exempts Clarence H. Branscombe, assistant supervising engineer, Public Buildings Administration, Federal Works Agency, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of one year ending August 31, 1942". The end is recorded as August 31, 1942 (1942-08-31), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative. MOMMSEN-I recheck: APP Clarence H, / GPO Clarence H. in the operative sentence; punctuation only, same full name and term.
